name: files
description: Read, write, and list files on the shared machine. Relative paths resolve in the shared workspace.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read a text file. Relative paths resolve inside the shared workspace every agent can see.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Write a text file, creating folders as needed. Overwrites unless append is true.

tools.name: list
tools.description: List a folder. Defaults to the shared workspace.

tools.name: delete
tools.description: Delete a file or empty folder. Waits for the user's approval.
